item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00071","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C20","C06","C05"],"selected_candidate_label":"C20","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C20 is a highly plausible drafting template. The child reproduces its distinctive succession formula almost verbatim: the combined incapacity of the Secretary and Under Secretary, followed by a numbered list of departmental officers acting in a specified order until appointment of a successor or cessation of the incumbent's absence or sickness. It also closes by revoking prior succession directives. C06 is nearly identical in general form but applies upon incapacity of the Secretary alone, making C20 the closer concrete model. C05 contains the same succession machinery but uses a less similar provision-by-provision format.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"In case of the death, resignation, absence, or sickness of the Secretary of State and the Under Secretary of State","parent_excerpt":"In case of the death, resignation, absence, or sickness of the Secretary of the Treasury and the Under Secretary of the Treasury","explanation":"Near-verbatim triggering condition, with only the department and offices adapted."},{"child_excerpt":"the following-designated officers of the Department of State shall, in the order of succession indicated, act as Secretary of State until a successor is appointed or until the absence or sickness of the incumbent shall cease","parent_excerpt":"the following-designated officers of the Treasury Department shall, in the order of succession indicated, act as Secretary of the Treasury until a successor is appointed or until the absence or sickness of the incumbent shall cease","explanation":"Distinctive operative sentence and temporal limitation are reproduced almost word for word."},{"child_excerpt":"All prior orders or other Presidential documents designating officers to perform the duties of the Secretary of State ... are hereby revoked.","parent_excerpt":"[DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] ... entitled \"Designating Certain Officers To Act as Secretary of the Treasury in Case of Absence or Sickness of the Secretary\", is hereby revoked.","explanation":"Both conclude by revoking the prior directive governing the same departmental succession."}]}
